title: A Model-threshold Dimension Bound and Sharp Critical Ends for Smooth Singular Sets of Constant Positive $σ_k$-curvature Metrics
summary: Let $k\in\mathbb N$ satisfy $1 0$ must obey \[ p\leq p_k(n), \] where $p_k$ is the model threshold determined by $\Hh^{p+1}\times\Sn^{n-p-1}$. When $k=2$ and $n=m^2$, we construct a smooth complete equality example on $\Sn^n\setminus\Sn^{(m^2-m-2)/2}$. We also prove that the strict inequality $p<p_k(n)$ holds under a finite positive linear-contact hypothesis.
